verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the rendezvous or relay servers is a fair question for a remote-access product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents TeamViewer offering on-premises or self-hosted relay or broker infrastructure. The only related mention is a community user looking for a self-hosted alternative, which says nothing about TeamViewer's own capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the rendezvous or relay infrastructure so session traffic stays on infrastructure I run
